picks.name: Montavilla Jazz Festival
picks.description: Portland's beloved neighborhood jazz festival fills Montavilla's streets and venues with live jazz performances all day. Multiple stages, local artists, and a great neighborhood vibe — free and open to all.

picks.name: Halloween Swamp Meet
picks.description: A free Halloween market at Oaks Amusement Park featuring vendors with gothic, vintage, horror, and all things creepy-cool. A great early-season dose of Halloween for all ages.

picks.name: Earth, Wind & Fire
picks.description: Legendary funk and R&B icons bring their electrifying live show to the outdoor stage at McMenamins Edgefield. Tickets required — Take advantage of this break in the rain!

picks.name: Craig Robinson
picks.description: Stand-up special from the beloved comedian and musician best known from The Office and plenty more. A late-night show at Helium Comedy Club — grab tickets before they sell out.

picks.name: East Portland Tabletop Arcade
picks.description: Drop in for free tabletop gaming at Midland Library — board games, card games, and more in a welcoming, all-ages environment. No registration needed, just show up and play.

picks.name: Wildwood: Follow the Crows
picks.description: A free community art bike ride exploring Portland's public crow installations. Part 1 departs OMSI Plaza at 1 PM; Part 2 follows at 2:30 PM. All skill levels welcome — just bring your bike and curiosity.

picks.name: Zeds Dead
picks.description: Toronto-based bass music duo Zeds Dead headlines the Bridge City Block Party on the waterfront. A huge outdoor show to close out the long weekend — get your tickets now.

picks.name: Art in the Pearl
picks.description: One of Portland's most beloved annual art festivals returns to the North Park Blocks for Labor Day. Dozens of fine artists, live music, food, and a great vibe in the Pearl District. Free to attend all day.

picks.name: Sunflower U-Pick
picks.description: Pick your own sunflowers at Bella Organic Farm on Sauvie Island — a classic end-of-summer outing with sweeping field views and the island's laid-back charm. A perfect Labor Day day trip.
